errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите години, показани в последователен ред от 2004 до 2019 година с единичен интервал между всяка година.
errors.evidence: This description is incomplete and misleading. It omits the primary structural feature of the chart: the x-axis is divided into two distinct groups, "Внос" (Import) and "Износ" (Export), each containing the years 2004-2019. It is not a single continuous time series.

errors.text_span: комбинираната височина на натрупаните стълбове показва общата стойност на вноса и износа
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. For any given year, the height of a bar shows either the total value of imports or the total value of exports, not their combined value. The chart presents two separate sets of bars for imports and exports.

errors.text_span: най-високите стойности са през 2017 година със стойности приблизително 17 и 14 съответно
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The highest values for both imports and exports are in 2019, not 2017. The peak import value is in 2019 (over 17), and the peak export value is in 2019 (over 16). The values for 2017 are approximately 16 for imports and 13 for exports, not 17 and 14.

errors.text_span: Диаграмата показва, че общата стойност на вноса и износа нараства през годините, с някои колебания.
errors.evidence: The phrase "общата стойност на вноса и износа" (the total value of imports and exports) is ambiguous. It is unclear whether it refers to the sum of the two, or to the individual trends of each. The description should clarify that the total values for both imports and exports show a general increasing trend independently.
